source: Original SRPP frozen same-input pure functions, no network IO

config.payday_convention: Monthly 15th cash paydate. The final month earns contractual monthly salary times inclusive employment days divided by actual calendar days; earned final wages remain payable on the 15th even after retirement. Future employer settlement dates and bonus eligibility are planning assumptions.

income_tax_withholding.note: D-076 records Steven's actual payroll withholding as 10% of salary and bonuses. This is cash withheld from pay, not a final annual income-tax assessment.

voluntary_labor_pension.note: Keep the existing 6% voluntary contribution. It reduces spendable cash before retirement and remains locked until age 60; it is not added to the pre-retirement investable-cash contribution.

annual_salary_increase.frequency: every March 1; bonus uses salary on payment date

planned_living_costs.proration_method: Display only: annual August-2026 living budget TWD750000 includes all taxes and routine car repairs; home/appliance TWD50000 annual average is additional. Shown payroll taxes consume the living envelope; other annual investment/settlement taxes are handled by the full monthly model. The model never deducts this displayed surplus/budget again.

revalidation.reason: The 116 (2027) NHI premium schedule and labor-pension wage brackets were not officially published as of 2026-08-27. Recalculate the ledger if either changes; the 2027 ordinary labor-insurance rate is set from the existing statutory step schedule.

config.recurrence_note: Explicit paydates override projected recurring months. Future bonus payment months are planning assumptions, not an employer calendar. Do not infer an unearned termination-month salary or a guaranteed payment from a candidate date.

final_month_convention.labor_and_employment_insurance_and_self_: partial month uses insured days / 30; full month uses 1 regardless of month length
final_month_convention.employer_nhi: full monthly premium only if still employed on the last day of the month; otherwise transferred coverage is within the normal living budget
final_month_convention.bonus: contractual salary on payment date, only if still employed on that date; employer confirmation required

pension.policy: 3000000 is the August 2026 balance. Add employer 6% of earned regular salary after August through retirement, March raises and partial final month, plus the user-confirmed payroll-bracket employee 6% contribution. Projected account earnings use the current 1.7108% reference as simple interest on the August balance and later timed contributions; this is a planning proxy, not a guarantee on the August total. Do not add a second guarantee payment without the complete contribution/earnings history. One withdrawal after retirement and age 60; application the next day when retirement is after age 60. Cash is modeled 30 days later. Car purchase remains on 2030-10-16 from existing liquidity if the benefit has not arrived; no duplicate reservation. Bear investments use the five-batch ladder.
pension.note: The dated car event is debited once on 2030-10-16. If the labor-pension cash has already arrived it is earmarked until that date; otherwise existing liquid assets bridge the car before the later receipt. No second 1.4M deduction or reservation is allowed.
pension.amount_basis: nominal TWD opening balance at balance_as_of_date

return_assumption.mode: simple-interest forward planning proxy based on current guarantee reference, not an exact statutory guarantee
return_assumption.future_rates: hold latest published rate as an explicit assumption; actual monthly guarantees may change
return_assumption.legal_guarantee: Compare cumulative actual earnings and cumulative guaranteed earnings over the whole contribution period at claim; only any shortfall is supplemented, never add both

expected.earnings_basis: simple-interest planning proxy; exact lifetime guarantee requires contribution and prior-earnings history
expected.employer_basis: 6% of earned regular salary; bonuses excluded
expected.posting_convention: One receipt after retirement and age 60; application the day after retirement if already 60; cash 30 days after application. Includes final earned contributions; actual account posting must be confirmed.

policy.indexation: Claim-cohort annual-average CPI. Compare previous-year annual average with claim-year/last-adjusted annual average; round percentage to 2 decimal places. At >=5%, increase by actual accumulated percentage from May next year, paid June-end; reset reference after adjustment. Age-based reduction or increase is permanent and uses 4% per year prorated by completed claim-age months, capped at 20%.
policy.verification_required: Planning estimate assumes the age-60 claim qualifies: insurance history must reach 15 years and insured employment must end before claim. The TWD 20,017 base benefit and highest-60-month wage/service record are not independently verified; no unverified service-year increase is added for later claims.
